title: Adyen raises revenue forecast on acquisition boost, shares soar
title_zh: Adyen 因收购增加而上调收入预测，股价飙升
summary: Adyen raised its revenue growth forecast on Thursday, sending the shares 11% higher ‌and offering investors some relief after a year during which the ‌Dutch payments processor lost more than a third of its market value.
summary_zh: Adyen 周四上调了收入增长预期，导致股价上涨 11%，并让投资者在这家荷兰支付处理商市值蒸发了三分之一以上的一年后松了口气。

title: Expert urges investors to spread bets across the 'AI universe'
title_zh: 专家敦促投资者将赌注分散到“人工智能领域”
summary: STORY: Mussio also noted that "investors are right to concern themselves" with companies' capital expenditures on AI buildout."The market is rewarding those businesses that can finance the CapEx still within the guise of their cash flow from operations," Mussio said.
summary_zh: 故事：Mussio 还指出，“投资者对公司在人工智能建设上的资本支出感到担忧是正确的。”Mussio 表示，“市场正在奖励那些能够以运营现金流为幌子为资本支出提供资金的企业。”

title: Google’s Pixel 11 isn’t the story; Gemini AI is

title: Nvidia partners with Goldman Sachs, BlackRock to fund AI build-out — but there's one big risk
title_zh: 英伟达与高盛、贝莱德合作资助人工智能建设——但存在一个很大的风险
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) is partnering with BlackRock (BLK), Goldman Sachs (GS), Blackstone (BX), and other major firms on Wall Street to fund its AI build-out.
summary_zh: 英伟达 (NVDA) 正在与贝莱德 (BLK)、高盛 (GS)、黑石 (BX) 和华尔街其他主要公司合作，为其人工智能建设提供资金。

title: CoreWeave, Nebius soar as AI spending powers growth
title_zh: 随着人工智能支出的增长，CoreWeave 和 Nebius 飙升
summary: CoreWeave (CRWV) and Nebius (NBIS) shares skyrocket following earnings, as revenue surges to “stupid” levels and demand for AI infrastructure continues to soar. Both companies are benefiting from an AI spending boom that is accelerating faster than Wall Street expected.
summary_zh: CoreWeave (CRWV) 和 Nebius (NBIS) 的股价在盈利后飙升，因为收入飙升至“愚蠢”的水平，并且对人工智能基础设施的需求持续飙升。两家公司都受益于人工智能支出热潮，其加速速度超出了华尔街的预期。
